webkit.finding: The small 996x350 default-context reference has a different partial-alpha RGB readback from the full 996x2748 willReadFrequently context. The actual committed head exactly matches the full native source, canonical commit and actual baseline heads.

ds051_original_baseline.evidence_kind: Actual original and candidate engine frames rendered with native canvas
ds051_original_baseline.finding: The original profile darkens partially transparent head-edge RGB when it stores premultiplied color in ImageData. Candidate pixels match the frozen avatar source. Requiring the rejected baseline head hash would preserve this artifact.

exact_reference_contract.source: Fetch and verify the immutable avatar hash and 996x2748 dimensions.
exact_reference_contract.construction: Draw at 0,0 on a full native willReadFrequently canvas; commit full ImageData to an equally sized willReadFrequently canvas.
exact_reference_contract.comparison: Exact RGBA hash for [0,0,996,350]; no tolerance, masks, skipped pixels or per-shirt exception.
exact_reference_contract.non_target_frames: All 42 unaffected shirts retain exact full-frame comparison to the original baseline.
exact_reference_contract.old_target_baseline_differences: Recorded as evidence, including old head hashes and changed-pixel bounds.

registration_determinism.finding: Native CI exposed platform-dependent floating-point tails only in area-ratio diagnostics. Delivered geometry was identical.
registration_determinism.correction: Compute ratios from integer determinants of the serialized four-decimal mesh; serialize diagnostic ratios to nine decimal places. Retain full-precision fold checks and additionally reject a folded serialized mesh.

final_browser_validation: Separate CI runs validate the corrected references and complete app; this diagnostic record grants no owner approval.
